prose:
A Techmeme excerpt attributed to Bloomberg reports record net foreign selling of Taiwanese shares, putting November outflows so far at $33.1 billion and linking the move to AI valuation worries and a broader technology sell-off. The excerpt compares the partial month with October's previous record.

The supplied Bloomberg link is only the homepage and does not expose the underlying article, methodology or exact observation cutoff. This is therefore an attributed market snapshot, not a verified full-month total, causal identification or investment recommendation. The generic URL also appears on unrelated political coverage; that does not make this story a duplicate of the governors' AI-regulation proposal.
highlights: Coverage is limited to an attributed feed excerpt
Original data and cutoff were not inspected
Reported selling does not isolate a single cause
Shared homepage URL is not shared story identity
No portfolio or trading action was taken
